annotation.title_clean: UN Regulation No 157 – Uniform provisions concerning the approval of vehicles with regards to Automated Lane Keeping Systems
annotation.title_en: UN Regulation No 157 – Uniform provisions concerning the approval of vehicles with regards to Automated Lane Keeping Systems
annotation.authors_or_issuer: UN/ECE World Forum for Harmonization of Vehicle Regulations (WP.29), published in Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (L 82/75)
annotation.summary_en: UN Regulation No 157 sets uniform type-approval provisions for Automated Lane Keeping Systems in M1 passenger cars up to 60 km/h. It covers system safety, fail-safe responses, driver handover, human-machine interface, object detection, data recording (DSSAD), cybersecurity, safety-management audits and test specifications.
key_provisions_or_claims: Type approval of M1 vehicles with ALKS limited to 60 km/h on roads with physical separation and no pedestrians or cyclists.
System must manage all driving situations without unreasonable risk, perform minimum risk manoeuvre if the driver does not respond to a transition demand.
Driver availability monitoring, override and safe transition demand/HMI requirements.
Mandatory DSSAD data recording, cybersecurity (UN R155) and software update (UN R156) compliance.
Manufacturer safety management audit, incident reporting, and track and real-world testing by technical services.
